title: Household-Earner Allowance: Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Requests for Larger Households With Wage and Benefit Income
content:
**Rule.** On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, a household-earner allowance is added to the response days by the household's size and the income documents received: a household of at least 5 people with both pay stubs and a benefit statement or letter received adds the large-household days, 10 days; a household of at least 3 but below 5 people with both pay stubs and a benefit statement or letter received adds the two-earner days, 7 days; any other household adds none.

"A benefit statement or letter" is an unemployment benefit statement or a Social Security benefit letter received for the case. Household size is the size recorded on the case.

## Matrix

| Household size on the case | Pay stubs received | Benefit statement or letter received | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 or more | Yes | Yes | 10 days |
| 3 or 4 | Yes | Yes | 7 days |
| 1 or 2 | Yes | Yes | None |
| Any | Yes | No | None |
| Any | No | Yes | None |
| Any | No | No | None |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A household of 4 with pay stubs and a Social Security benefit letter on file: 7 days.
- A household of 5 with pay stubs and an unemployment benefit statement on file: 10 days.
- A household of 6 with pay stubs only: none.
